name: Salad Bunker
tagline: The operating system for people who grow lettuce in a warehouse.
positioning: Salad Bunker runs the crop schedules, harvest logs, and buyer invoices for small indoor farms so you can stop keeping it all in a damp notebook.

hero.h1: You grow the greens. We handle the spreadsheet hell.
hero.sub: Salad Bunker is the boring back office for indoor farms: seeding calendars, rack-by-rack yields, and restaurant invoices that actually get paid. No agronomy PhD required.

features.title: Rack-level yield tracking
features.description: Log grams per tray, per light, per week. Spot the shelf that's quietly underperforming before it eats your margin.

features.title: Seed-to-invoice in one place
features.description: Every batch links from germination to the chef who bought it. When a restaurant disputes an order, you have the paper trail.

features.title: Recipes that don't drift
features.description: Lock your nutrient dosing, photoperiod, and airflow per crop. New hire on day one runs the exact same basil as your best grower.

features.title: Harvest schedules that nag
features.description: Salad Bunker pings the crew when a tray hits maturity, so you stop discovering bolted arugula on a Sunday.

features.title: Buyer standing orders
features.description: Weekly wholesale orders auto-generate pick lists and invoices. Fewer 6am texts asking 'you got mizuna this week?'

features.title: Climate log that remembers
features.description: Pull temp, humidity, and CO2 history for any room and any day, for the health inspector who shows up unannounced.

testimonials.quote: Before Salad Bunker my yield data lived on three whiteboards and a texting thread. Now I know exactly which rack is freeloading. Fired that rack.
testimonials.name: Danielle Osei

testimonials.quote: We onboarded two part-timers last month and they ran our microgreens without me hovering. The recipe lock is the only reason I sleep.
testimonials.name: Marco Tillman

testimonials.quote: The restaurant invoicing alone paid for the seats. Chefs stopped 'forgetting' orders once everything was on a real pick list.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For the one-room operation still doing math on a napkin.
For farms with staff, standing orders, and opinions about airflow.
For multi-site operators who've outgrown heroics.

homepage.footerBlurb: Salad Bunker is software for small indoor farms. We are not a farm. Please stop mailing us seeds.
